1879072543.name: Set Trap
1879072543.desc: You carefully place a snare on the ground to trap your foes.

1879073567.name: Return to Rivendell
1879073567.desc: This enables you to quickly return to Rivendell. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879097887.name: Banner of Terror
1879097887.desc: You place a terrible banner bearing the Eye of Sauron to weaken your opponents' will to fight.

1879113119.name: Gambler's Strike
1879113119.desc: An attack that applies a damaging Red gamble to the target.

1879205791.name: Springtime Pony
1879205791.desc: A pony from the Springtime Festival.

1879209887.name: Steed of the Lore-master
1879209887.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the lore-master.

1879210655.name: Hatchlings: Scytode Brood
1879210655.desc: You summon one of your scytode brood to aid you in battle. Scytode brood hatchlings are not as durable as the strong brood, but utilize ranged attacks to keep opponents at bay.

1879232415.name: Ranged Resolution
1879232415.desc: Even in the face of overwhelming numbers, your resolution dismays your foes, draining morale from enemies around you and restoring your morale.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879261983.name: Cry Vengeance
1879261983.desc: When an enemy is defeated, you let out a Cry that damages nearby enemies.

1879266847.name: Wide Sweep
1879266847.desc: A sweeping cut in front of a Dúnadan can strike several foes at once.

1879305759.name: Scrapper Chicken
1879305759.desc: Summons a scrapper chicken to brighten your day.

1879311263.name: Nature's Vengeance
1879311263.desc: Your deep bond with Nature allows you to purge evil powers from even the darkest of hearts.

Evading an attack applies an Incoming Healing bonus to you. This can only trigger once every 12 seconds.
DNT - parrying an Attack builds threat.  Evading an Attack builds Wrath.

1879313695.name: Little Tundra Cub
1879313695.desc: Summons a little tundra cub to brighten your day.

1879344415.name: Murder
1879344415.desc: The hobbitses must die. They must die! Gollum! But… not yet. No… not yet…\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Requires the breaking of the Promise.</rgb>

1879354399.name: Claim the Ring
1879354399.desc: All these troubles could be ended, and the might of Mordor brought low, if only you were to claim the Ring...\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Requires the temptation of the Ring.</rgb>

1879354911.name: Muster in the Udûn Foothold
1879354911.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to the Udûn Foothold.

1879360799.name: Lhingris Crawler
1879360799.desc: Brings out a Lhingris crawler to keep you company.

1879415711.name: Portent of Strength
1879415711.desc: A quick burst of strength, increasing the amount of damage you do.

1879416223.name: Spotted Pig
1879416223.desc: Summons a pig to keep you company.

1879457567.name: Desperate Shield
1879457567.desc: In desperation, strike enemies in front of you with your broad shield, restoring morale for each foe hit.

1879466271.name: Disengage
1879466271.desc:
Sometimes, the best movement is to survive.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay Finisher:
 Enables Re-centre.</rgb>

1879467807.name: Final Strike (Dual)
1879467807.desc: Consuming all of your Wrath, you put all your energy into one devastating area attack to defeat up to 5 enemies before you.

1879495327.name: Memory of Hope
1879495327.desc: A Memory of Hope can be used to restore the Morale of an ally.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Restores 25% of your target's Morale.</rgb>

1879508639.name: Bright Grodbog Protector
1879508639.desc: Summons a bright grodbog protector to accompany you on your travels.

1879508767.name: Muster at Zajâna
1879508767.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Zajâna in Kighân in Mûr Ghala.

1879516831.name: Drop Red Mushroom
1879516831.desc: Drop your current mushroom.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>The mushroom will explode when dropped.</rgb>

1879517983.name: Guile
1879517983.desc: Strike your enemies with the speed and guile of a spider.

1879520031.name: Caravan Trade Goods Camel
1879520031.desc: Summons a camel to carry your caravan goods on your travels.

1879522079.name: Plant a Patch of: Saffron
1879522079.desc: Plant some seeds and make a lovely patch of saffron.

1879523743.name: Whirlwind
1879523743.desc: A full body rotation turns your weapon into a whirlwind, occasionally spinning up a dust devil.

1879532575.name: Wolf-hounds
1879532575.desc: Your skills have a 1% chance to afflict your target with a severe wound and leave it taking more damage. Ends when it triggers.
